integrity: Definitions, exact polynomial identities, finite base calculations, and all-parameter proof accompany a standalone direct GF(2) matrix checker. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to k=2,3 and n>=2k+1. It does not claim the finite nullity entries of Torrence and Torrence Table 1 as new. Six finite weight enumerations are rigorously lifted to all n by cyclic-module decomposition. Prior unindexed or inaccessible weight-enumerator work cannot be ruled out.
title: Exact quiet-pattern weight enumerators for two generalized Petersen families
